tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rigs gsum spyi dbang gi brgyud 'debs utpal phreng mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang gsang ba'i bdag /ind+ra bhu ti grub brnyes 'chi med zhabs// 'phags pa klu sgrub klu yi byang chub dang*// ye shes rdo rje rnams la gsol ba 'debs// grags 'byor shes rab bla chen sa skya pa// rje btsun grags pa sa skya paṇḍi ta// shākya grags dang de dbon kun dga' dpal// dar ma ye shes rnams la= /bag ston che dang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan zhabs// ngag gi dbang po byang chub seng ge dang*// gzhon nu blo gros ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*// kun dga' dbang phyug rnams la= /ratna wardha lha mchog seng ge dang*// sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen brang ti pa// sgrub khang pa dang shes rab 'byung gnas zhabs// lhun grub dpal ldan rnams la= /sangs rgyas phun tshogs bstan 'dzin lhun grub dang*// nam mkha' bsam 'grub kun dga' blo gros zhabs// nam mkha' 'chi med kun dga' bstan 'dzin dang*// mkhyen brtse dbang po rnams la= /gsang bdag rdor 'dzin blo gter dbang po dang*// brag ra chos rje mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang*// rigs brgya'i khyab bdag su bha ṣi ta'i mtshan// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sngon 'gro'i rim pas rang rgyud legs sbyangs nas// bdag mdun grogs po lta bu'i rnal 'byor dang*// skyon brgyad spangs pa'i bzlas brjod la 'bad pas// grub gnyis kun dga' gsar pa myong bar shog /bsnyen sogs rnam par dag byas 'gro kun la// dmigs med snying rje'i kun bslangs dkyil 'khor che// 'jug cing skal ba dang 'tsham chos bstan pas// 'brel tshad don ldan 'jam dbyangs rjes 'gror shog /'khor 'das shes bya rtogs pa'i blo gros dang*// lus can srid las gdon pa'i snying stobs dang*// tshar gcod rjes su 'dzin pa'i mthu stobs sogs// rigs gsum yon tan rgya mtsho thob par shog

/ces pa 'di'ang bskul ba po'i dgongs bzhed bzhin rmongs brtul wa gand+ris sbyar ba'o// //shu bhaṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
